acceptanceCriteria: A test with a configured clean filter shows the probe does not execute it.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: dogfood check's status probe (check.go requireCleanChange via flow.git) can still run git clean filters.

Expected: it uses the hardened probe that disables filters.

Acceptance: a test with a configured clean filter shows the probe does not execute it.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: DCW-V0-045 dogfood tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: dogfood check status probe can still run git clean filters; move to hardened probe
